name: list_crews
description: List the crews available to one incident with their identifier, number of members, skills (any of make_safe, overhead_line, switching, underground_cable), depot location as a GeoJSON Point, and availability. Availability is free, or held when the crew is already committed to a proposal awaiting approval or approved, in which case the holding proposal id and its status (waiting_approval or approved) are given. Optionally filter by availability (free or held) and by a required skill. Read-only. Plan work only for crews reported free with at least two members: storm work requires a minimum two-person crew, and a crew held by another proposal must not be double-committed. No crew member names or personal identifiers are returned.

incident_id.description: Incident identifier, a ULID with the inc_ prefix, matching ^inc_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{26}$.

availability.description: Optional filter, one of free or held. Omit for all crews.

required_skill.description: Optional filter: only crews holding this skill. One of make_safe, overhead_line, switching, underground_cable.

correlation_id.description: Optional correlation identifier, a ULID with the corr_ prefix. Echoed in the response and in every log line.
